name: claude-statusbar
description: Model, effort, 5h usage, context and plugin activity of Claude Code in the VS Code status bar.

commands.title: Claude Status Bar: Open Session Transcript

claudeStatusBar.plugins.description: Plugins and MCP servers to show. Empty = detect the ones you installed.

claudeStatusBar.contextWindow.description: Context window size per model ID, e.g. {"claude-opus-5-5": 1000000}. Haiku defaults to 200k, other models to 1M.

claudeStatusBar.warningThreshold.description: Percent at which text turns yellow.

claudeStatusBar.errorThreshold.description: Percent at which text turns red.
